description.en: Terminal UI components for React, built on Ink, OpenTUI, and shadcn conventions.
description.zh: 专为 React 与 Web 打造的纯正终端风格组件库，融合 Ink 与 shadcn 规范。

content.en: termcn provides developers with genuine terminal and command-line style components designed for the browser. Drawing architecture from Ink and OpenTUI while adhering to shadcn copy-paste norms, termcn lets you embed interactive ASCII windows, ANSI logs, and shell prompts directly in React apps.
content.zh: termcn 是一套将命令行与终端审美完美带入浏览器的专用 React 组件库。借鉴了 Ink 与 OpenTUI 的底层排版逻辑，并深度契合 shadcn 即拷即用分发模式，它提供了具有纯正等宽排版、ANSI 颜色渲染、闪烁光标与流水日志输出的终端交互卡片。
